summary.en: The 26th Red Army and local guerrillas resisted the first KMT encirclement campaign against the Shaanxi-Gansu border base.

description.zh: 1934 年 2 月起，国民党军对陕甘边革命根据地发动第一次“围剿”，红二十六军主力转入外线作战，地方游击队坚持照金、南梁一带。起止月份为通行说法，待页码级核对。

The main force of the 26th Red Army moved to exterior lines while local guerrillas held the Zhaojin and Nanliang areas. Start and end months follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: KMT forces used the Xiang River as a fourth blockade line to encircle the Central Red Army; the Red Army broke through at heavy cost.

description.zh: 1934 年 11 月，国民党军以第四路军（何键部）和桂军（白崇禧部）等依托湘江构筑第四道封锁线，集结重兵堵截中央红军。红军在全州、兴安之间强渡湘江，突破封锁线，但伤亡重大。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In November 1934, KMT forces including the Fourth Route Army (He Jian) and Guangxi forces (Bai Chongxi) established a fourth blockade line along the Xiang River and concentrated troops to intercept the Central Red Army. The Red Army crossed between Quanzhou and Xing’an, breaking the blockade but suffering heavy casualties. Unit designations and command relationships follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: KMT Guizhou forces defended the Wu River to block the Red Army’s advance toward Zunyi.

description.zh: 1935 年 1 月，国民党黔军王家烈部在乌江沿岸设防，企图阻止中央红军北上。红军在江界河等渡口突破防线，打开进军遵义的门户。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。

The Red Army broke through at Jiangjiehe and other crossings, opening the way to Zunyi. Unit designations and command relationships follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Establishes Mao Zedong’s leadership in the Party and the Red Army; a turning point of the Long March.

description.zh: 1935 年 1 月 15 日至 17 日，中共中央政治局扩大会议在遵义召开，总结第五次反“围剿”失败和长征初期失利的教训，实际确立了毛泽东在党中央和红军的领导地位。
description.en: From January 15 to 17, 1935, an enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau was held at Zunyi. It reviewed the failures of the fifth counter-encirclement campaign and the early Long March, and effectively established Mao Zedong’s leadership in the Party and the Red Army.

summary.en: The 26th and 27th Red Armies resisted the second KMT encirclement campaign.

description.zh: 1935 年 2 月起，国民党军调集兵力对陕甘苏区发动第二次“围剿”，红二十六军、红二十七军并肩作战，至 6 月先后攻克多座县城。兵力与起止月份为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: From February 1935, KMT forces concentrated troops for a second encirclement campaign against the Shaanxi-Gansu Soviet area. The 26th and 27th Red Armies fought side by side and took several county seats by June. Troop strengths and start/end months follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

Institution names follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: KMT forces blockaded the Red Fourth Front Army, attempting to prevent it from joining the Central Red Army.

Dates and command relationships follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: The First and Fourth Front Armies meet at Huining; the Second Front Army later meets the First at Jiangtaibao.
